scope: Independent read-only wiring review of installed stage r3 service sentinel/telemetry, matcherv3/rank/reviewv2 integration. No stage source/test writes, live service/platform/model calls or live DB writes. Offline tests use only mocks/in-memory/test-only DB.

closures.name: persist_before_await
closures.evidence: service.py:592-601 increments persistent call/pair counters and writes {} for each actually attempted pair before awaiting judge. Missing/bad/transport/cancel cannot look unattempted on concurrent GET.

closures.name: good_pair_independent_review
closures.evidence: service.py:614-651 keeps each revalidated valid pair, counts missing invalid pairs, and passes every positive support through prepare_claims/review_batch. service.py:652-659 applies only source-rebound reviewed decisions; failed review is not cached.

closures.name: sentinel_not_dropped_on_read
closures.evidence: service.py:1651-1655 uses is not None. Job {} beats old stored match decision. learning_support.py:16-20 rejects a present invalid/unsealed/old decision; literal fallback exists only when no saved attempt/decision is present.

closures.name: partial_fault_observable
closures.evidence: service.py:624-627 records teaching_pair_validation_failures, upstream_partial and fixed warning. Entire unsuccessful batch gets a fixed upstream warning/status rather than fake empty success.

closures.name: cache_and_reentry_caps
closures.evidence: service.py:570-579 validates current review seal/fingerprint before cache reuse, derives remaining call budget from persisted progress; reviewed count saved before review await; key includes content fingerprint with matcher version. Old invalid/v1 data cannot revive.

closures.name: model_budget_and_source_reserve
closures.evidence: service.py:469-474 reserves at most45seconds inside task total; max20candidate pairs,4perpoint,10percall,2judge+1review persisted. New skill matches alwayspartial, so legacy _rerank supported-only group adds no call for these rows.
